mapper.insert: INSERT INTO shopping_cart(user_id, merchant_id, product_type, product_id, quantity, selected) VALUES (#{userId}, #{merchantId}, #{productType}, #{productId}, #{quantity}, #{selected}) ON DUPLICATE KEY UPDATE id = LAST_INSERT_ID(id), quantity = quantity + VALUES(quantity), selected = VALUES(selected)
mapper.sql: SELECT sc.id, sc.merchant_id, m.name AS merchant_name, sc.product_type, sc.product_id, CASE sc.product_type WHEN 'DISH' THEN d.name ELSE s.name END AS product_name, CASE sc.product_type WHEN 'DISH' THEN d.image_path ELSE s.image_path END AS image_path, CASE sc.product_type WHEN 'DISH' THEN d.price ELSE s.price END AS unit_price, sc.quantity, sc.selected FROM shopping_cart sc JOIN merchant m ON m.id = sc.merchant_id LEFT JOIN dish d ON sc.product_type = 'DISH' AND d.id = sc.product_id LEFT JOIN setmeal s ON sc.product_type = 'SETMEAL' AND s.id = sc.product_id
mapper.delete: DELETE FROM shopping_cart WHERE id = #{cartItemId} AND user_id = #{userId}
mapper.select: SELECT * FROM shopping_cart WHERE user_id = #{userId} AND id IN #{id} ORDER BY id FOR UPDATE

SELECT d.id AS product_id, 'DISH' AS product_type, d.merchant_id, d.name, d.image_path, d.price FROM dish d JOIN merchant m ON m.id = d.merchant_id WHERE d.id = #{productId} AND d.merchant_id = #{merchantId} AND d.status = 'ON_SALE' AND m.business_status = 1
SELECT s.id AS product_id, 'SETMEAL' AS product_type, s.merchant_id, s.name, s.image_path, s.price FROM setmeal s JOIN merchant m ON m.id = s.merchant_id WHERE s.id = #{productId} AND s.merchant_id = #{merchantId} AND s.status = 'ON_SALE' AND m.business_status = 1
SELECT NULL AS product_id, NULL AS product_type, NULL AS merchant_id, NULL AS name, NULL AS image_path, NULL AS price WHERE 1 = 0
FOR SHARE
mapper.delete: DELETE sc FROM shopping_cart sc JOIN order_detail od ON od.order_id = #{orderId} AND od.product_type = sc.product_type AND od.product_id = sc.product_id JOIN orders o ON o.id = od.order_id AND o.merchant_id = sc.merchant_id WHERE sc.user_id = #{userId} AND sc.quantity <= od.quantity
mapper.update: UPDATE shopping_cart sc JOIN order_detail od ON od.order_id = #{orderId} AND od.product_type = sc.product_type AND od.product_id = sc.product_id JOIN orders o ON o.id = od.order_id AND o.merchant_id = sc.merchant_id SET sc.quantity = sc.quantity - od.quantity WHERE sc.user_id = #{userId} AND sc.quantity > od.quantity
